description.zh:
是否注册成为PAI数据集。取值如下：
- true：将标注结果注册为PAI数据集。
- false：直接将标注结果导出至OSS目录，不注册数据集。
description.en:
Specifies whether to register the result as a PAI dataset. Valid values:
- true: Registers the annotation result as a PAI dataset.
- false: Exports the annotation result directly to an OSS folder without registering it as a dataset.

description.zh: 任务ID。如何获取任务ID，请参见[ListTasks](~~454662~~)。
description.en: Job ID. For information about how to obtain a job ID, see [ListTasks](~~454662~~).
Tenant ID. For information about how to obtain a tenant ID, see [ListTenants](~~454649~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun openitag export-annotations --tenant-id GA000W134 --task-id 1500002518306500608 --target PAI --oss-path oss://000-hz-oss.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/output/ --register-dataset true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun openitag GET /openapi/api/v1/tenants/GA000W134/tasks/1500002518306500608/annotations/export --region cn-hangzhou --RegisterDataset true --Target PAI --OssPath 'oss://000-hz-oss.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/output/' --header "Content-Type=application/json"
